title: REMOTE-COMPACTION-ENABLE-1 (apex-576): FLEET-SHAPE pin for the v2 remote arm - NO config_patch. The live ~/.grok/config.toml carries features/remote_compaction_v2=true (flipped 2026-09-24, operator sign-off; REMOTE-COMPACTION-1 .139 verified the arm), and the hermetic home inherits it verbatim - so this case proves the flag rides from the LIVE CONFIG tier end-to-end, the shape the fleet runs in. Same wire contract as MGW-COMPACTV2-01: streaming POST /v1/responses (NOT a unary /responses/compact route - that route exists upstream but the harness never calls it; probes: 400 contract error on terra naming input|previous_response_id, 500 'COMPACT responses is not supported for vertex_ai' for gemini, 401 unrecognized path for glm/qwen vLLM) advertising x-codex-beta-features: remote_compaction_v2 with the trailing compaction_trigger item; exactly one compaction output item (cmp_*/encitem_ lineage) + response.completed; post-compact turn clean. SELECTOR: the v2 compact request carries NO x-grok-req-id (the xai-compact- tag is the LOCAL self-summarize arm, session_compact.rs) - the beta-features header is the unique v2-arm discriminator and the where-filter. PREDICTED: PASS = one beta-advertising request, both protocol markers, HTTP 200, compaction item in the stream, no acp_error. RED = 0 beta-advertising requests (live-config flip did not ride - the point of this case) or 2+ (the .82 strip-retry storm class).
reason: Premise not preserved (r3 section 6.3 option O-3, the plan default, confirmed by the operator's answer to Q-1 on 2026-10-30): this case's subject is that features/remote_compaction_v2=true rides from the LIVE ~/.grok/config.toml tier with no config_patch, and the operator turned that flag off in the live config on purpose; it will be turned on again only after a per-model-row version of remote compaction v2 replaces the global flag (operator-answer-Q1-remote-compaction-v2-20261030.json). The recorded live state is features.remote_compaction_v2 = false (r3 section 6.2; live-rows-20261030-tf-retired.json top_level.features), so the case can only print its own predicted RED (0 beta-advertising requests). Giving it a config_patch (r3 section 6.3 O-2) is rejected because that would destroy its subject; the v2 remote arm stays covered by the self-pinning MGW-COMPACTV2-01 and RT-C5.
unblocks_at: Q-1 re-opened by the operator: remote compaction v2 is re-armed for the live config, changing the state r3 section 6.2 records (r3 section 6.3 O-1 or the Agents.md section 12 exception; per the Q-1 answer, only once a per-model-row version replaces the global flag). Then re-read this case's premise against that shape, set disabled=false, and rewrite the now-inverted premises of WS9-S05-COMPACT-RESUME and COMP3-STORM-VLQ-VLG in the same item with a written reason each (r3 section 6.3: the two directions never merge).

steps.prompt: Think step by step: why does a hash table degrade toward a linked list as the load factor climbs past 1? Show the collision math, then the answer.

ndjson.label: LIVENESS: the /compact step and the post-compact turn both completed — the collector consumed the compaction item, history was replaced, and the session continued. An acp_error here = the collapse class (01a09be2 lineage) -> report-and-stop.

wire.label: ONE COMPACT ATTEMPT: exactly one /v1/responses request advertising x-codex-beta-features: remote_compaction_v2 rode the wire. 0 = the remote v2 arm did not fire (flag/row/fusion premise failure); 2+ = the .82 strip-retry storm class (the live probe showed the proxy accepts the trigger, so a clean 1 is expected).

REMOTE ARM (header): the compact request advertises exactly x-codex-beta-features: remote_compaction_v2 (codex_remote_compaction_v2_beta_header, client.rs — idempotent merge over the row's default header; no other request in this deployment carries the marker).
REMOTE ARM (body marker): the compact request carries the trailing {"type": "compaction_trigger"} input item (COMPACT-BOUNDARM-1, apex-ayl.82). The live probe proved the proxy models it.
V2 BODY CONTRACT: parallel_tool_calls=true — set unconditionally by codex_compaction_request_body (ordinary turn requests carry it as null/absent: run-1 req-005 vs req-007 delta).
PROXY ACCEPTED: the remote compaction request returned HTTP 200 — no 403 (routing/authorization) and no Family-9 400 'Unsupported Responses API input item type: compaction_trigger'.

COMPACTION ITEM: a response stream carried a compaction output item (item.type=compaction) — the v2 contract's terminal payload (response.output_item.done + response.completed consumed by CodexRemoteCompactionV2Collector). Turn streams never carry it, so a hit identifies the compact response.
MARKER RIDE RECORD (recon, non-scoring): which request(s) advertised the v2 beta feature (expected: exactly the compact request).
COMPACTION ITEM ID (recon, non-scoring): the cmp_* item id the proxy minted (encitem_ affinity-class lineage, kiloecho matrix row AZ).
